rows.resolution_note: Abstract sentence 2 defines the outcome data as the authors' own analysis of WMH volume in 52,560 UK Biobank participants: an own analysis of individual-level data defined by a phenotype and a measured protein set, not only by a number of participants (rule C); no listed release, accession or citation is given.
rows.quote: Association and Mendelian Randomization analyses of WMH volume and 2,923 plasma proteins in 52,560 UK Biobank participants identified the lysosomal protease cathepsin B (CTSB) and the mitochondrial enzyme Enoyl-CoA Hydratase Domain Containing 3 (ECHDC3) as the top candidates associated with WMH volume.
